title: FERPA — de-identified aggregate research
query: For our annual program evaluation, can I get aggregate graduation rates by ethnicity?

consultation.query: For our annual program evaluation, can I get aggregate graduation rates by ethnicity?

decision.query: For our annual program evaluation, can I get aggregate graduation rates by ethnicity?
decision.llm_response:
Allowed under 34 CFR § 99.31(b)(1) (de-identified records).
Confirm: removal of all PII has been done with a reasonable de-identification determination accounting for other reasonably-available information.

advisor_reply: Yes, you can obtain aggregate graduation rates by ethnicity for your program evaluation. These summary statistics are permissible under FERPA regulations when all personally identifiable information is removed. After generating the report, please ensure our institutional research team confirms de-identification and maintains the aggregated data at a group level without individual student details. I recommend maintaining this documentation for our institutional records.
